Message:
A black power
overflowed from within me,
pouring into the Lance,

and the relic meant to save
the world regained its strength.

However, the Lance had
only awakened because
of the demon’s power.
That did not mean
it had forgiven me.

When I took the Lance in hand,
those tragedies began to
flood my mind.

The moments I stole
the lives of so many people...
my family...the young boy
who adored me...
with this lance...!
“Ahh... AAAAAAAHH...!”

I wish to not see
any of them—only to forget.
But, the voices of
everyone crying for help...

The tiny fingertips of the one
calling me Big Sis...
They seize my arms
and refuse to let go.

As if telling me to
hurry and fall into Hell.

...To think that,
even for a moment,
I was happy at the possibility
of being forgiven...
How hideous a creature I am...

There is no other way
for me to atone for my sins...
than to pay with my life...

Please, hurry and put an end...
to this vile and filthy life...

Someone like me...
must not be allowed to live!

—I want you...to live...!
No matter what sins
you may have committed...!
...! Alexandra?

—Please...
don’t give up on living...

...Ahh...
It looks like I have
made another mistake...

I wanted to die
so I could be at peace...
To think I tried calling
such a weak wish...atonement...

—Hmm. I see you’ve returned.
How entertaining indeed.

I shall enjoy seeing
just how long that bravado
of yours lasts.
